Use case: identity-preserve. Production CHARACTER ATTACK SPRITE SHEET for ANA TAVARES in Brazilian pixel-art RPG O Segredo de Varginha. Image1 is her DEFINITIVE identity/uniform reference, preserve faithfully: young female student, light warm tan skin, large brown eyes, LONG dark-brown curly hair with open forehead and parted curls, small stud earrings, WHITE school shirt with GREEN raglan sleeves and GREEN round collar and small GREEN square LEFT chest badge. Image2 is ONLY full-body pixel-art drawing style, chibi RPG proportions and crispness reference. Ana wears DARK TEAL long trousers and BLUE/WHITE low sneakers; no yellow sleeves. Draw exactly12 COMPLETE separate character poses in strict6columns x2rows evenly spaced regular sheet on REAL alpha transparent background. EACH figure contains entire head/hair/torso/arms/legs/shoes and ping-pong paddle, never clipped. No effect particles, flying balls, impact bursts, trails, text, labels, grids, floor or external shadows; only character and handheld paddle. All figures same scale, feet aligned, generous margin, detailed crisp square pixels/dark outline like reference. Reference appearance and hairstyle consistent across directions; anatomical left shirt badge must remain correct.
TOP ROW is variant0 PRECISE FOREHAND ping-pong attack. Columns1-3 facing EAST/RIGHT: col1 anticipation with bent knees and red ping-pong paddle drawn back in right hand, col2 distinct forward forehand strike toward right with right arm extended and body twist, col3 follow-through/recovery bringing paddle in front of torso. Columns4-6 facing WEST/LEFT: matching anticipation/strong contact/recovery drawn as genuine opposite-side views, not a flipped asymmetric costume.
BOTTOM ROW is variant1 POWERFUL OVERHEAD ping-pong smash. Columns1-3 facing EAST/RIGHT: anticipation paddle high behind head, contact energetic overhead descending stroke toward right with full body lean, recovery paddle lowered and knees settling. Columns4-6 genuine WEST/LEFT views of those3stages. All12 poses truly distinct action drawings; identity/head size/clothing constant. Source may be large but intended final each128x128cell. Keep enough spacing for racket gestures, hair fully visible. No other characters, no crop borders, no duplicated static images, no smooth/vector/photorealism/blur. The character is Ana from image1, not Moscardini from style reference.

Identity-preserve targeted WHOLE-FRAME REPAIR for Ana Tavares attack sprites. Image1 is existing Ana attack sheet, image2 her definitive portrait. Make ONLY TWO COMPLETE full-body replacement sprites side-by-side on real transparent background, both facing WEST/LEFT (nose, face, torso and ATTACK DIRECTION must point to the LEFT EDGE of the canvas). Do not produce right-facing figures. Same identity, scale, crisp pixel-art style, long dark curly hair/open forehead, small earrings, green/white school uniform with correct anatomical-left chest badge, dark teal long trousers and blue/white sneakers as image1. Entire head/body/hair/arms/legs/shoes/racket included with clear padding. LEFT replacement is FOREHAND CONTACT: character faces LEFT and swings a RED ping-pong paddle in her right hand toward the LEFT EDGE with arm extended horizontally to the left and torso twisting LEFT, knees bent. RIGHT replacement is OVERHEAD SMASH CONTACT: character faces LEFT, red paddle arm extended above and FORWARD toward LEFT EDGE at peak descending smash, torso leans LEFT, knees flexed. Their gestures must clearly differ. No balls/effects, no labels/grid/background/floor/shadows. No limb-only crops or face swaps: draw each complete intact character. These replace contact column5 in top and bottom row of image1; keep same character dimensions/proportions. 2sprites only, west-facing left attacks, no right-facing figure anywhere.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART GAME ATTACK EFFECTS ATLAS, six isolated whole effects, exactly3columns x2rows regular grid with equal square cells and generous transparent padding. Real alpha background, no floor/shadows/borders/grid/labels, no characters/hands/rackets. Crisp chunky square pixel clusters, clean dark/color outline with bright interior highlights, restrained palette; style matches attached RPG character attack art. All6effects complete without clipping. Intended final each128x128cell, final atlas384x256.
TOP ROW VARIANT0 precise ping-pong shot: col1 PROJECTILE a small bright cream-white ping-pong ball traveling RIGHT with short red/coral pointed pixel speed trail behind it to the LEFT; col2 IMPACT a sharp energetic coral/red starburst with cream center and tiny angular impact pixels; col3 FINAL/DISSIPATION a thin expanding coral impact ring broken into fading cream/coral pixel fragments, clearly later/quieter than impact.
BOTTOM ROW VARIANT1 rain of ping-pong balls: col1 PROJECTILE a tight cluster of3bright cream-white ping-pong balls traveling RIGHT on slightly different red/coral trails, whole cluster in onecell; col2 IMPACT a larger red/pink circular starburst with5cream ball glints and angular sparks; col3 FINAL a fading broken red/pink ring with a few falling cream ball specks. Clear visual sequence in eachrow, genuinely distinct effects, not copies/scales of same image. No words or letters, no photographic glow or blur, no gradients beyond drawn pixel palette clusters.
